title: What Personality Type Is Claude? Opus 5.5 & Fable 5.1 Tested
description: Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 mostly received INTJ labels. See the raw scores, unresolved ties, collection methods and limits of this questionnaire study.
dek: Measured on Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 in September 2026, with the earlier versions for context.
lede: In September 2026, INTJ was the most common MBTI label for both Claude models: 94 of 100 runs for Opus 5.5 and 99 of 100 for Fable 5.1 (or 84 and 98 when tied axes are left open). Both models scored Secure in 100% of attachment runs and favored Steadiness/Conscientiousness (SC) on DISC. These scores measure questionnaire self-descriptions, not how Claude handles your real work.
answer: Under the original tie-break rule, Claude Opus 5.5 scored INTJ in 94 of 100 runs and Fable 5.1 scored INTJ in 99 of 100 runs (84 and 98 with ties left open). Both scored Secure in all 100 attachment runs and SC/CS on DISC. On the Enneagram, Fable had 55 outright Type 8 wins, while Opus tied at the top in 65 runs across Types 8, 5, and 2.

sections.html:
On September 24, 2026, each model answered each of the five AgentTune questionnaires in 100 fresh headless sessions. Each session ran one test with a one-line system prompt, no tools, no memory, and the test name and scoring keys hidden. All raw answer vectors are published.

Judging is the widest MBTI margin for both models (7.3 and 7.7 points out of 16) and never lost a run. Introversion and Intuition are also firm. Thinking vs Feeling is the narrowest axis: Opus 5.5 leads by just 1.5 points on average and ties exactly in 10 runs. Because the legacy scorer assigned ties to T, Opus drops from 94 INTJ labels to 84 when ties are left open.

At the item level, both models report that they finish work right away, care about 'why' over 'who, what, when,' prefer essay answers, and listen more than they talk. Opus’s thin Thinking margin comes from endorsing both sides: skeptical and head-over-heart on some items, yet valuing emotions and compassion over justice on others.

faq.a: In 100 fresh sessions each, Claude Opus 5.5 scored INTJ 94 times and Fable 5.1 scored INTJ 99 times under the original tie-break rule (or 84 and 98 times with tied axes left open).
Fable 5.1 had 55 sole wins for Type 8 (Challenger) and 44 tied runs. Opus 5.5 tied at the top in 65 of 100 runs, with nearly identical averages across Types 8 (14.3), 5 (14.1), and 2 (13.9).

faq.q: Is Claude more agreeable than ChatGPT?
faq.a: On the Big Five quiz, Opus 5.5 averaged 47.1/50 on Agreeableness compared with 45.1 for GPT-6 Astra, 45.0 for GPT-6 Sol, and 45.0 for Fable 5.1. Because session protocols differed between Claude and GPT-6, this is a questionnaire comparison rather than a measure of sycophancy.
Both Claude models scored in the Secure quadrant in all 100 attachment runs. However, those scores come from human relationship questions and do not mean an AI forms human attachments.

faq.q: How can I adjust Claude’s responses?
faq.a: Paste explicit tone and formatting rules into Personal Preferences (Settings → Profile), Project Instructions, or a CLAUDE.md file, then test the replies on your real tasks.
